description.value: Oliver's Tearoom is the High Tea section of Dickens Sweets and British Museum, an immersive British-themed complex in downtown Chilliwack that also houses a Victorian-era museum, a replica Tally Ho pub, Pickwick's Pie Shop, and a British sweet and grocery shop. The multi-storey museum takes visitors through Royal history, a vintage office, Fred's Toyshop, and a Titanic exhibit. Cycling visitors can pick up takeout savories — sausage rolls, steak pies, and baked goods — from Pickwick's, making it an unusual and memorable detour.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names 'Oliver's Tearoom' but the website reveals this is one component of the larger 'Dickens Sweets and British Museum' complex at 45945 Alexander Ave., Chilliwack. The website confirms an outside patio (Pickwick's page) and takeout items (pies, sausage rolls described as available to take home or enjoy on the patio), but provides no evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or other cycling-specific amenities. The website lists two phone numbers — 604.793.1981 as the main shop number and 604.703.1981 as the tearoom reservations line — where OSM uses the tearoom number (+1-604-703-1981), which does appear on the website.
concerns: OSM name 'Oliver's Tearoom' refers only to the High Tea section of the larger 'Dickens Sweets and British Museum' complex — the parent business may be a more appropriate or complete listing for the WWC directory.

Phone number discrepancy: website prominently advertises 604.793.1981 as the main shop number and 604.703.1981 as the tearoom reservations line; OSM uses the tearoom number. The main shop number 604.793.1981 may be more reliable for general contact.
OSM record has no address — address populated from website (45945 Alexander Ave., Chilliwack, BC).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM listing names only the tearoom sub-component of a larger and potentially more cyclist-relevant complex; no cycling amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are confirmed, and a human reviewer should assess whether the full Dickens Sweets complex at this address warrants a more comprehensive listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: An outside patio is mentioned on the Pickwick's page ('enjoy at home or on our outside patio'), which may offer some visibility or informal bike-leaning opportunity, but this is not confirmed as a designated bike parking area.
